_note: UMTAS are the anti-tank missiles under the wing. Nothing in their name says so, and geometrically they are long, thin, paired and off the centreline - which is also what a tailplane looks like - so they were classified as tail. Scaling the tail then threw them nine metres.
_note_wing: Cube_govde_0 and Cube.011_govde_0 were both classified wing. 'Govde' is Turkish for fuselage, and the boxes agree: 20.00 x 12.39 m and 18.48 x 8.18 m, each the whole aircraft. Borrowing the Akinci's wing therefore handed over two copies of the entire airframe, the second sitting 1.96 m aft of the first. They are the welded hull, so they are body, and the wing is a cut through them.

wing.comment: Measured with scripts/measure-region.py. Along the length axis the wing runs 0.50 to 0.81, reaching the full half-span, while the boom either side of it is 0.04 to 0.06 wide; the V-tail is at 0.00-0.12 and the nose beyond 0.85. Keeping a 0.10 band holds the 1 m fuselage and drops both wing panels, without touching either end.
